artifact.splitRule: scaffold-hash-mod10 (djb2 over the Murcko scaffold, buckets 0-1 test, 2-3 calib, 4-9 train)

endpointFamilyDefinitions.EC50: functional potency — concentration producing 50% of maximal biological response in a cell-based assay
endpointFamilyDefinitions.IC50: binding/inhibition — concentration producing 50% inhibition in the assay as reported
endpointFamilyDefinitions.comparisonMade: EC50 (functional) vs IC50+Ki (binding) for the SAME canonicalSmiles
endpointFamilyDefinitions.whyThisMatters: these are different physical quantities; a single pActivity axis representing both is internally inconsistent by construction

notMeasured.true_replicate_sd_median: only 6 same-endpoint replicate groups exist (floor for a usable estimate: 20). The assay noise floor is NOT established. An earlier version of this diagnostic reported 1.1212 by grouping replicates on molecule alone, which put a molecule's EC50 and IC50 in one bucket and called their difference noise; that number is WITHDRAWN and must not be quoted.
notMeasured.publication_overlap_pmid: the frozen pin carries no PMID/publication field, so PMID-level duplicate detection against any extension is impossible from this pin alone

exhaustiveEndpointSubsetScan.method: all 7 non-empty subsets of {EC50, IC50, KI}, each scaffold-split under the frozen rule, compared against MIN_TRAIN=150 and MIN_TEST=40

statusRationale.whatIsFormallyESTABLISHED: Over an EXHAUSTIVE enumeration of all 7 endpoint-family subsets of THIS pin, under THIS split rule and THESE gate constants, no endpoint-homogeneous subset satisfies MIN_TRAIN=150 AND MIN_TEST=40. Both subsets that satisfy the size floors are endpoint-MIXED. This is a finite, checked enumeration, not an extrapolation.
statusRationale.whatIsNOTEstablished: That MAE <= 1.0 is unachievable. That would require a bound on achievable error — e.g. an assay noise floor — and the noise floor is NOT_MEASURED (6 replicate groups). No IMPOSSIBILITY_PROOF is claimed.
statusRationale.whyNotCalledImpossibilityProof: Calling a measured constraint conflict a mathematical impossibility would be an overclaim of exactly the kind this repository refuses. CONSTRAINT_CONFLICT states precisely what was checked and precisely what was not.

extensionRequirement.status: PROPOSED — HUMAN DECISION REQUIRED, not a diagnostic result

derivation.note: the observed allocation is NOT the nominal 60/20/20: scaffold-hash-mod10 allocates by scaffold, so row proportions follow scaffold sizes

extensionRequirement.caveat: N=53 is an EXPECTATION under the observed proportions. Each new scaffold lands in bucket djb2(scaffold)%10, deterministic but unknowable before the scaffolds exist, so the realised allocation may differ. 53 is therefore PROPOSED, never a measured guarantee, and it supersedes the reviewed package's '>=40 rows' only as a better-derived proposal.
extensionRequirement.qualitativeRequirement: the extension must be endpoint-HOMOGENEOUS (EC50-only) human GLP-1R on NEW Murcko scaffolds. Novel-but-mixed rows inherit the same 1.7618 contradiction and do not help.

acquisitionStatus.method: real HTTP reachability check, no fabrication
acquisitionStatus.conclusion: EGRESS_BLOCKED for every named source. No rows retrieved, no hashes computed, no scaffold counts derived, no independence claimed. Target identity P43220 (human GLP-1R) could NOT be validated against UniProt from this runtime and remains a declaration, not a verified fact.
